description: This file is an __init__.py module for the 'grok' package within the 'pipecat.services' namespace. It primarily sets up a deprecated module proxy for the 'grok' package, importing all contents from the local 'llm' module and replacing the module with a proxy object for deprecation handling.

classes.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy
classes.description: Class used to create a proxy that marks the module as deprecated, forwarding attribute access to the original module.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor method for DeprecatedModuleProxy, initializes the proxy with the original module's attributes and deprecation message.
